decision.scope: Bounded native storage encoding reuse and immutable aggregate inspector.

contractMap.contract: DB23 catalogue, migrations, TEXT record/event storage, public declarations and signatures unchanged.
Record validators return detached finite plain JSON with fixed record-field order and preserved opaque nested key order.
Native session refs/owner checks, transaction requirement, event validation, exact JSON encoding, independent v2 sequence and ascending cursor order unchanged.
Legacy journal, immutable approval identity/fingerprint, approval expiry before terminal event and transaction publication remain unchanged.
Canonical request identity, receipt/duplicate binding, actual native admission and queue ownership are unchanged.
Session-document namespace/byte checks, detached return, parse of prior body, CAS revision and rollback remain unchanged; metadata-only CAS shortcut was rejected.
Run/message order, bounded whole-exchange model history, required anchors and opaque replay are unchanged.
provider.media.admitted remains after owner checks and before capacity gates/row insertion; its event copy remains validated and admission rollback remains transactional.
Archive validation, ordered-row logical hashing, authority and native unknown/noReplay/cancellation behavior receive no production edits.

independentValidation.freshFixtureDigestQualification: Each independent run has real random identities/timestamps; source-to-archive byte/order equality is exact within that run. Cross-baseline/candidate equality comes separately from the deterministic paired fixture.

sameConditionComparisonReview.interpretation: The saved bytes count avoided transient JSON serialization/allocation work. SQLite allocated/logical bytes, queries, events and archive history remain identical; wall/heap samples add no SLA or leak proof.

reviewFindingsResolved: Fingerprint and refuse nonempty primary rollback journal before immutable opening; fingerprint effects journal.
Enforce stream hash byte cap after the initial stat.
Reject case-insensitive schema DBSTAT shadowing before reading contents.
inspectorReview.safety: Explicit externally established closure; immutable read-only primary connection, no Engine or checkpoint/VACUUM/migration/CREATE dbstat. Query/time/output/schema/VM bounds and aggregates/digests only.
inspectorReview.qualification: Immutable ignores locks. Persistent before/after signatures cannot prove absence of transient concurrent writes; file atime is outside equality. CAST(column AS BLOB) logical bytes differ from record payload/page allocation; effects files are fingerprinted only.

limitations: Missing Original DB/raw report prevents historical per-table, per-category or freelist attribution; fresh fixtures cannot replace that evidence.
No persistent byte reduction, pruning, compression, migration, execution authority change, unknown-outcome resolution or replay is claimed.
Finite ScriptedProvider/private fixtures and focused checks; no whole suite, long soak, Desktop/PTY/Windows/GUI/provider-account acceptance.
Independent fixture setup failures were corrected and preserved; all scoped production/runtime checks then passed.
